problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. The packages are as follows:
* Package Alpha: weight 61kg
* Package Bravo: weight 60kg
* Package Charlie: weight 46kg
* Package Delta: weight 62kg
* Package Echo: weight 55kg
* Package Foxtrot: weight 38kg
* Package Golf: weight 68kg
* Package Hotel: weight 61kg
* Package India: weight 47kg
* Package Juliet: weight 41kg
* Package Kilo: weight 30kg
* Package Lima: weight 43kg
* Package Mike: weight 51kg
* Package November: weight 46kg
* Package Oscar: weight 36kg
* Package Papa: weight 31kg
* Package Quebec: weight 57kg
* Package Romeo: weight 49kg
* Package Sierra: weight 50kg
* Package Tango: weight 69kg
* Package Uniform: weight 42kg
* Package Victor: weight 51kg
* Package Whiskey: weight 56kg
* Package X-ray: weight 38kg
* Package Yankee: weight 37kg
* Package Zulu: weight 45kg
* Package Asterisk: weight 52kg

Each truck can carry a maximum load of 100 kg. Assign all packages to trucks using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be placed on exactly one truck, and the total weight loaded onto any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
